caption: The drawing displays a square textile pattern predominantly in red and off-white colors. The central figure is a stylized bird with outstretched wings, decorated with dotted and lined patterns, situated diagonally across the composition. Surrounding the bird are botanical elements, including leaves and clusters of berries rendered in the same red color. In the upper left corner, there is a triangular geometric pattern comprising alternating red and off-white triangles arranged in a grid, bordered by a strip of small circles. The border of the square is filled with repeating red circles and oval motifs, and along the bottom edge, a wider band features a series of oval medallions containing stylized plant motifs, which are connected by smaller leaf shapes. The entire design is composed with precise, repeating shapes and clearly defined edges against the off-white background. The artist's name, "A. Chudom," is inscribed in the bottom right corner outside the pattern.
title: Homespun Coverlet
